no_adcom_quote.quote: No Advisory Committee meeting was planned or held for this application.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for VORAXAZE (glucarpidase, BLA125327). The Cross-Discipline Team Leader review states no AC meeting was planned or held, and the Summary Review and Office Director memo both explain the application was not referred to the Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee because it did not raise significant public health issues regarding the role of glucarpidase in treating toxic methotrexate levels. Because no committee was convened, there are no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval.
